text: After this you can select measurements and recognize when work needs an authorized specialist.

Plan measurements before entering a site. Existing bills, nameplates, logs, schedules, and trend files can answer many questions without intrusive tests. Choose instruments that match the quantity, range, accuracy, environment, and required calibration. Do not enter restricted spaces, open energized panels, or override controls without the site-approved procedure and qualified staff. Stop if conditions are unsafe or unclear.
